moat_source: spectrum partnerships and carrier lock-in (50+ MNOs, ~3B subscribers, $1.2B contracted commitments); evidence: exclusive-style carrier agreements are real switching-cost assets, but the technology is unproven at fleet scale and Starlink is a funded fast-follower

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3.

sensitivity_key_driver: 2030 revenue scale (constellation completion and carrier monetization rate)
primary_model_risk: Revenue emergence: FY2026 guidance is $150-200M; base case requires ~$3B revenue by 2030 - a 15-20x scale-up gated by launch cadence, funding, and unproven fleet-scale engineering. No DCF input past 2026 is anchored to a reported figure.
expectations_gap_key_variable: probability of full-constellation success: at $85.13 the market prices the bull case (full global constellation, premium wholesale economics) as the central outcome; our base case assigns it 25% and still gets only $42 expected IV
top_5_bull_arguments: 50+ MNO partners covering ~3B subscribers is a distribution asset no competitor (including Starlink) has assembled
$1.2B contracted commitments and a $175M stc prepayment show carriers paying before service - real demand signal
~$3.5B cash funds the 2026 build-out without immediate dilution
US Government revenue provides a non-carrier monetization path already in guidance
If the 243-satellite constellation works at scale, bull-case IV (~$111) exceeds today's price - the option is real, just mispriced
top_5_bear_arguments: ~165x guided FY2026 revenue; expected IV ($42) is half the current price even crediting a 25% bull probability
Q1 2026 net loss of $191M with 100+ satellites still to fund - more capital will be needed beyond the $3.5B
Fleet-scale interference/handoff engineering is unproven; the technology risk is rated High for a reason
Starlink direct-to-cell can compress wholesale pricing before AST reaches scale
The +31.2% week was sympathy momentum from the Rocket Lab-Iridium deal, not an AST fundamental - momentum unwinds
thesis_breakers: A launch failure destroying multiple Block 2 satellites
FY2026 revenue guidance cut below $150M or BlueBird 1-5 operational slip into 2027
A dilutive capital raise above ~15% of shares outstanding
A major carrier partner (AT&T or Verizon) signing a competing direct-to-cell exclusive
FCC or landing-rights setback in a top-5 market
position_size_recommendation: 0% at current price; the bull option becomes interesting near or below expected IV (~$42), roughly half today's price
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: pre-scale company with negative earnings; no sourced ratios exist. DCF is explicitly degraded: only FY2026 guidance ($150-200M) and cash ($3.5B) are reported figures; all post-2026 cash flows are constructed scenarios - hence confidence_level low.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. No verified historical multiple range captured in pass1/claude_pass1. Verified datapoints only: +31.21% past week, market cap ~$33.04B vs $25.43B quoted a week prior (pass1 web quotes).
